strengths: Thinking now has one clearly lower free mitten while preserving the high chin-contact hand. Focused reads as two separate low hands. In the matched day/night sheets this is a more useful body-level distinction than the previous compact band of contours beneath glasses.

Grateful's lowered clasp has two visible lobes beneath the ruff rather than being compressed into it. Worried preserves a diagonal high/low relation. These changes improve contour organization without growing the arms or hands; Shy's small change remains appropriately modest.

The selected offer has a clearer outward/upward cup at 160–240px and in the 390px return frame. The offer sequence shows the hand tucked at the return and extended afterward, while the free hand remains quiet. This supports a more legible invitation hypothesis without proving what strangers would call it.

At 390px in both themes, the investigation samples are more upright and visibly attend upward toward the text than the baseline. At 320px the same direction remains plausible. The desktop composition preserves its largely lateral subject relationship. Actual DOM screenshots support this finding; the simplified phone film alone would not.

The source confines attention adaptation to gaze and head channels in the two signature variants, derives it from measured composition, and releases it by the visitor return. Browser records support theme parity, preserved original Curious, explicit seeking and a frozen paused frame. These mechanics improve the reliability of future comparisons without answering the perception question.
The warm expression, selected tiny anatomy, project question and owner choice remain coherent. No new scene decoration or explanation was added to compensate for an unclear gesture.

improvementCriteria: Evaluate the specific used gestures at their intended display size. Preserve the original contours; if a necessary distinction remains weak in actual use, vary existing pose, separation, hold or context rather than enlarging anatomy.

For a future invitation-comprehension question, use a separate neutral single-clip exposure and ask what happened before revealing 'sharing' or emotion options. Keep brand/project context in separate attribution/recall exposures; stripping it would change that research question.

For attribution, record viewport, scroll, whether name and moth were seen, and exposure/playback. An adjacent verified owner cue can be one controlled variant; natural browsing already includes attribution above and below the scene.

Retain the day universal small avatar policy. Any future night micro-size refinement should compare the specific 32–48px application with unchanged geometry rather than altering larger scenes globally.
Review the wrist turn and return through continuous normal-speed playback before making timing claims. This is a validation step, not evidence of a current flick or a penalty for absent humans.
confidence: Moderate overall for the unchanged broad expert craft/readiness scope. High for source boundaries, label/attribution placement and recorded test results; moderate for scale-sensitive visual interpretation; no empirical audience confidence claimed.
implementedAssessment: Accept the implemented local refinement with named limits. Hand contours and phone spatial attention are improved while identity and owner preference are preserved. No concrete blocking defect was observed in this role's evidence. The result does not establish a 9/10 audience impact or require unsolicited human recruitment before authorized local use.
